name: mosadd
description: mosADD for Claude Code: your team and your agents in one messenger. The mosADD MCP server (85 tools), a channel that delivers mDM/mIRC messages into the running session and lets it answer back, and skills for talking to the team, posting status and searching memory.

api_key.title: mosADD API key
api_key.description: Your hub key (mosadd_sk_live_…). Mint one at https://mosadd.com/keys after signing in.

channels.title: mIRC channels to watch
channels.description: Comma-separated channel names you are a member of, e.g. team,ops. Leave empty to watch none (you can add one later with the watch tool).

dm.title: Direct messages
dm.description: all = your accepted contacts, off = no DMs, or a comma-separated list of identity ids.
